item.title: Neil Diamond's journey to fame shines in 'A Beautiful Noise'
item.description: A Beautiful Noise: The Neil Diamond Musical is a true story of how a kid from Brooklyn became an American rock icon, now playing in Dallas at the Music Hall at Fair Park.

item.title: "Sinners" leads search interest for 2026 best picture Oscar
item.description: "Sinners" has emerged as the most searched-for Best Picture nominee ahead of the 2026 Oscars, with an average of 20.1 million monthly searches, representing approximately 40% of the total search volume across all 10 nominated titles.

item.title: Mansfield, McKinney students honored for independence films
item.description: Students from Mansfield and McKinney, Texas, have won awards in the 2026 C-SPAN StudentCam documentary competition for their films exploring the influence of the Declaration of Independence, with Shayaan Yousuf earning a second-prize award and Ean Scott and Tyler Jorgenson receiving a third-prize award.

item.title: McLaren Dallas: Luxury meets electrified performance innovation
item.description: McLaren Dallas is showcasing two of the automaker's newest supercars, the 750S and the Artura, which offer different approaches to performance, with the Artura highlighting McLaren's push toward electrified innovation.

item.title: Garland seeks artists for 'Art at Every Turn' program
item.description: The City of Garland is seeking local artists to submit applications for "Art at Every Turn," a program that transforms traffic signal boxes into public art with vinyl wraps, in order to reflect the culture and creativity of the community and deter vandalism.

item.title: Granville Arts Center presents Alice Burla in Chopin & Mozart
item.description: Pianist Alice Burla will join the Garland Symphony Orchestra for a performance of classical works on March 13 at the Granville Arts Center.

item.title: Harmonize with your furry friend at 'Yoga with Dogs' event
item.description: Experience mindfulness and canine companionship at "Yoga With Dogs" in Downtown Garland on March 17, led by expert Robbie and Master Yoga instructor Jenny Reitz.

item.title: Texas cities lead as affordable and rapidly growing hubs
item.description: Frisco, New Braunfels, McKinney, Allen, League City, Conroe, Lewisville, Pearland, Denton, Fort Worth and Grand Prairie have been ranked as the top 50 most affordable and fastest-growing cities in the US, with Frisco leading the list and homeowners in these cities retaining significant savings after cost-of-living expenses.

item.title: Barbie honors Opal Lee, "Grandmother of Juneteenth"
item.description: Dr. Opal Lee, a teacher, counselor, and community activist, was awarded the Presidential Medal of Freedom for her work in making Juneteenth a federal holiday and was honored with a Barbie Inspiring Women doll in her signature look.

item.title: Karamo guides guests in emotional healing and self-discovery
item.description: Karamo's show helps guests unpack their issues and encourages healing and growth, while authentically tackling topics such as infidelity, race, parenting, and complex family dynamics.
